trending_videos.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 | Multiplayer Trailer
trending_videos.description:
Weapons hot. Apex Attachments activated. Killstreaks online.

12 all-new 6v6 Maps, Kill Block and Ground War locked in.

This is Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer. Pre-Order now to get Early Access to the MW4 Beta: https://a.atvi.com/PreOrder-MW4

🎵 "The Devil Is a Lie" by Rick Ross feat. Jay-Z

Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat built around fluid
movement that provides greater control in every fight.

Day one, players deploy across all-new 6v6 maps set in visually and tactically distinct locations around the world. In addition, large-scale maps bring vehicle and infantry combat to locations shaped by the campaign’s global conflict. From tight, close-quarters combat to open battlefield engagements, Multiplayer is designed to keep every fight fast, tactical, and competitive. Kill Block introduces a dynamic new Multiplayer battleground where the map reconfigures layouts between rounds, reshaping sightlines, routes, and cover to keep players adapting in real time.
